name: Menger Sponge Raymarching
definition: A raymarching technique rendering a Menger sponge fractal using a signed distance function (SDF) combined with a floor plane, utilizing GLSL 120.
summary: Menger Sponge Raymarching is a procedural technique that renders the fractal using a recursive modulo-based signed distance function, distinguishing itself by efficiently approximating infinite detail within a bounded volume.
